name: bld2_lucas_sq_sub_five_fib_sq
statement: (n : ℕ) : (p3_lucas n : ℤ) ^ 2 - 5 * (Nat.fib n : ℤ) ^ 2 = 4 * (-1) ^ n
informal: Uses Mathlib2.an_cassini_int (with the definition Mathlib2.p3_lucas): the cast of p3_lucas n is 2 F(n+1) - F(n) (no truncation since F(n) ≤ 2 F(n+1)); expand (2F(n+1) - F(n))^2 - 5F(n)^2 = 4(F(n+1)^2 - F(n+1)F(n) - F(n)^2) and rewrite with Cassini F(n+2)F(n) - F(n+1)^2 = (-1)^(n+1), F(n+2) = F(n+1) + F(n).
